player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} deg urar n HighSociety (tamuɣli n 2 n yimyura).
Asrag n urar:  Mraw n tkeṛḍiṣṭ n prestij lant tettwazenzen-tent yiwen s deffir n wayeḍ.
Tzenzi:    Yal tazenza, xtar-d aɣref aɣelsan n 1-11, d ffegiḍ-t.
            • Tazenza tameqqrant teṛbeḥ tkeṛḍiṣṭ n prestij, d tettmager tkeṛḍiṣṭ n yidrimen.
            • Tazenza tameẓẓyant tettwaf tkeṛḍiṣṭ n yidrimen.
            • Tifrat -> tazenziwin-d zrin, d tkeṛḍiṣṭ n prestij nettɛedda tazenza.
Uddun:    Seld n mraw n tazenziwin, rnu **idrimen iliqen + isemmaḍen n prestij**.
            Amḍan *aqari n yidrimen* iṛbeḥ (tifrat yeqqnen -> aneṣṣif).

**Tasleṭ n tigawt**  →  xtar-d takarḍa t-yiwet am '[7]' neɣ '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ilaq ad yili s waṭas yiwen [X] n karti n imali.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Ur tesεiḍ ara tura takarḍa-nni n yidrimen.
